title: 5 steps to designing the life you want  | Bill Burnett | TEDxStanford
summary: TEDxStanford talk by Bill Burnett, executive director of Stanford's design program, on applying design thinking to your own life and career. He offers five practical tips such as getting curious, talking to people and trying things.
why: HN recommends it as a short intro to the Designing Your Life approach when people ask about career direction and finding meaningful work.
